title: Rounded box with a chamfered lid
prompt: Small box with a lid, printed side by side: the box is 70 × 50 mm outside with R6 vertical corners, 25 mm tall, 2 mm walls and floor, open at the top, centred on the origin on Z = 0. The lid is a 3 mm thick plate with the same rounded 70 × 50 outline, centred at X = 80, with a 1 mm chamfer all the way round its top edge. Make the lid's chamfer a chamfer feature.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
The lid's chamfer runs round its top edge: the lid's centroid sits at z = 1.4871 (1.5129 with the chamfer underneath)
Side by side: X from −35 to 115
The lid's top edge chamfered 1 mm all round (4 straight edges and 4 corner arcs)
Four conical chamfer faces at the lid's rounded corners

notes: Box: (70·50 − (4 − π)·36)·25 − (66·46 − (4 − π)·16)·23 = 86727.2 − 69511.8 = 17215.3. Lid: 3437.1·3 − chamfer (perimeter 202.7 × 0.5 mm²) ≈ 10293.5. Construction: chamfer reads the chamfer features the prompt asks for (no geometry equivalent in the report), so a correct part built otherwise fails only that test.
